Lord '''Semaradrid Maravin''' of [[House Maravin]] is a [[Cairhienin]] lord. 

== Appearance ==
He is hard-faced and dark eyed, with wings of gray at his temples. 

== Activities ==
He suffered numerous wounds in the Cairhien civil war and a limp from battles with [[Tear]].

He is highest ranked Lord from Cairhien sent to the [[Plains of Maredo]] where [[Rand al'Thor]] is gathering a massive army for the imminent attack on [[Illian]]. He is co-commander with [[Weiramon]].

He goes with Rand when Rand tries to deal with the Illian rebels loyal to Lord Brend.
He rides with Rand when Rand's forces attack the invading [[Seanchan]] just outside Illian. Rand does not trust him due to his House having an alliance with [[House Riatin]]. He leads [[Torean]], [[Maraconn]] and [[Ershin Netari]] into the final assault on the Seanchan.
